items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I didn't, I didn't know him personally, but I know of him.

ctx.x: Well, the spiritualist, they, they have a church, but they're like those mediums. They read, you know, they claim they can read and see the future and all like this. And they preach too. because a lot of theatrical people and smart people, some of them take, gets it as a racket and some may be sincere, I couldn't say, but it, it's nice money in it.
See, did you ever know a fellow named Johnny Dodds? He talked about it a minute ago.
I didn't, I didn't know him personally, but I know of him.
